protocol.split: Frozen pretrained forests; fresh validation and test seeds, distinct from original training and prior test study
protocol.pairing: Identical test damage, layout, observation draws and dropout for RF, legacy fit and sparse fit
protocol.noise: Declared Gaussian noise standard deviation supplied to sparse method; not estimated from hidden labels
protocol.drift: Common normalized offset is estimated from observations, not supplied to inverse fit
protocol.abstention: All-missing packets excluded from conditional accuracy and separately counted
protocol.metrics: Damage threshold 5%; RF location uses vote >=0.5; both inverse methods use severity >=0.05
protocol.uncertainty: Paired case-bootstrap intervals, one forest-training seed; no hardware/model-mismatch validation
protocol.search: Healthy + all 21 single-member fits + pairs among six best single-member residual fits
